title: Schnitzel with Mustardy Chicken
description: A classic German dish with a twist of Peruvian flavor, featuring crispy chicken topped with a tangy mustard sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, and Peruvian aji amarillo pepper powder.
Dredge the chicken in the flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured chicken in the beaten eggs and then coat in the mustard mixture.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until golden brown on both sides and cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Reduce heat to medium and add the chicken broth to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the Peruvian aji amarillo pepper powder and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the chicken with the mustard sauce spooned over the top and garnished with lemon wedges.
